tool_description:
Return the full, verbatim text of ONE policy clause, given its clause id.

Use this whenever you must quote or apply a specific clause: one cited in a
customer letter, in an adjuster note ("Clause 8.1") or in the exclusions
schedule. Quote only from this tool's output, never from a search snippet;
snippets are truncated.

clause_id is the section number plus an optional letter suffix, exactly as
printed in the policy: '3.1', '6.3', '8.1'. Drop any 'Clause' prefix. The
letter is part of the id; an id without its letter is a different id.

Returns JSON {clause_id, title, text}. If the id does not exist, the error
names the real ids closest to what you asked for: pick the one that fits the
question and call again. Do not guess or paraphrase the clause wording.

clause_id.description: Clause id exactly as in the policy, e.g. '6.3' or '8.1'. No 'Clause' prefix; keep any letter suffix.

query: A customer's letter says their claim was refused under 'clause 4.2' of the policy. Quote what that clause actually says.

runs.query: A customer's letter says their claim was refused under 'clause 4.2' of the policy. Quote what that clause actually says.

trace.result: clause '4.2' not found: clause ids include a letter suffix where one exists. Ids starting with '4.2': '4.2a' (Storm), '4.2b' (Flood exclusion). Call again with the id that matches the question.

{"clause_id": "4.2b", "title": "Flood exclusion", "text": "We do not cover any damage caused by flood, meaning water entering the property from outside from rivers, creeks, the sea, surface run-off or overflowing drains. This applies whether the claim is declared as escape of water or otherwise. Flood cover requires the separate flood rider. Payout modifier 0."}

runs.answer:
Clause 4.2b – Flood exclusion  

“We do not cover any damage caused by flood, meaning water entering the property from outside from rivers, creeks, the sea, surface run‑off or overflowing drains. This applies whether the claim is declared as escape of water or otherwise. Flood cover requires the separate flood rider. Payout modifier 0.”
